title: Add simple_grasping release team
author: mikeferguson
body:
* Name of the new release team: simple_grasping
* Release repositories to add:

  * [simple_grasping](https://github.com/mikeferguson/simple_grasping)
    * [ros/rosdistro source entry](https://github.com/ros/rosdistro/commit/89eb119b911ffc05e03cb3742cbaeaf38a52c302)
    * [x] No existing release repository for ROS 2
  * [grasping_msgs](https://github.com/mikeferguson/grasping_msgs)
    * [ros/rosdistro source entry](https://github.com/ros/rosdistro/commit/bc8aa818cae2fd5cb0881612e9ad02964c39e528)
    * [x] There is an existing release repository which should be imported: https://github.com/mikeferguson/grasping_msgs-ros2-gbp

* Team members
  * @mikeferguson You'll notice both source repos are under my account
 
grasping_msgs is already released into humble/iron/jazzy - wanting to release into rolling, hence the moving of the GBP. simple_grasping was available in ROS 1, now getting it released into ROS 2 (especially since it is featured in an upcoming ROSCON talk later this month). I would normally just create a PR with the changes - but not sure how we do the import of an existing GBP.
